question: Which of the following river is called 'Dakshin Ganga'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Godavari River **is referred to as the **Dakshin Ganga**.
 
• The **Peninsular River System **is the **largest**.
 
• It **originates **in **Maharashtra's Nasik area **and **empties **its water into the **Bay **of **Bengal**.
 
• **Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, **and **Andhra Pradesh **are among the states through which its tributaries flow.
 
• With a catchment area of **3.13 lakh sq. km,** it is **1,465 kilometres long. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Periyar:**

 
 
• **​**In the Indian state of **Kerala**, Periyar is the **longest river **and has the greatest capacity for discharge.
 
• One of the few perennial rivers in the area, it **supplies drinking water **to a number of significant communities.
 
 
 
• **Narmada:**
 
 
• **​**The Narmada River, also known as the **Reva **and formerly as Narbada or Nerbudda in English, is the **fifth-longest river **in India and the **longest west-flowing river** altogether.
 
• It is also the state of **Madhya Pradesh's **greatest flowing river.
 
 
 
• **Tapi:**
 
 
• **​**South of the Narmada River in central India, the Tapti River (sometimes spelt Tapi) flows **west **before emptying into the **Arabian Sea.**
 
• The river travels through the states of **Maharashtra, Gujarat, **and **Madhya Pradesh** for a distance of around **724 kilometres (450 mi).**
